plugins/agent-orchestrator/scripts/proof.summary:
{
  "purpose": "A deterministic verification utility that prevents \"checkbox fraud\" by scanning spec artifacts (spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md) for file references and using Git to prove each file was actually modified compared to origin/main. It ensures that task completion signals are backed by tangible code changes.",
  "layer": "Orchestrator / Verification",
  "supported_object_types": ["Generic", "Proof of Work", "Verification Report"],
  "usage": [
    "python3 plugins/agent-orchestrator/scripts/proof_check.py --spec-dir specs/0005-feature",
    "python3 plugins/agent-orchestrator/scripts/proof_check.py --spec-dir specs/0005-feature --json"
  ],
  "args": [
    "--spec-dir : Path to the feature specification directory containing artifacts to scan",
    "--project-root : Base directory of the git repository (defaults to current)",
    "--json : Renders the verification report in a machine-readable JSON structure"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md (Artifact sources)",
    "git diff --stat origin/main (Ground Truth delta)"
  ],
  "outputs": ["Detailed CLI report of modified vs. unchanged files", "Binary exit code (0=Pass, 1=Fail)"],
  "dependencies": ["git", "re", "subprocess", "pathlib"],
  "consumed_by": ["/agent-orchestrator_verify workflow", "Session Retrospective Protocol"],
  "key_functions": [
    "extract_file_refs(): Heuristic extractor that parses backticks and markdown links for code artifacts.",
    "check_file_modified(): The core validation engine that queries Git for file-level statistical changes against the main branch.",
    "run_proof_check(): Orchestrates the scan and generates cognitive friction messaging for AI systems when verification fails."
  ]
}
